tasks.subject: Task 0: Project scaffold & dev server
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Served page loads the module entry; node --test passes a smoke test.

**Files:** package.json, index.html, styles.css, src/main.js, tests/smoke.test.js, README.md

**Verify:** `npm test`; `npm run serve`.

```json:metadata
{"files":["package.json","index.html","styles.css","src/main.js","tests/smoke.test.js","README.md"],"verifyCommand":"npm test","acceptanceCriteria":["npm test passes","page serves with title Spellbloom, no console errors"]}
```

{"files":["src/content.js","tests/content.test.js"],"verifyCommand":"node --test tests/content.test.js","acceptanceCriteria":["4 scenes in order","glade >=8 valid spells","accessors behave per tests"]}
